Traditional automation relied on rules and triggers. Marketing Cloud Next goes further: AI agents understand buyer intent in real time, engage in two-way conversations, adapt content to every individual, and operate across accounts and buying committees 24/7 — so your pipeline never stops generating."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"What is Piper, the AI SDR Agent, and how does it work?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Piper is the #1 AI SDR agent, part of Marketing Cloud through the Qualified acquisition. Piper converts high-intent website visitors, form fills, and inbound email leads into pipeline 24/7 — engaging via chat, voice, or video; answering questions; and booking meetings directly on the right rep's calendar. All activity logs automatically in CRM. #1 on G2 in AI SDR Agents, 4.9/5 from 1,500+ reviews. Live in 30–45 days, no SI required."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How is Piper different from the Agentforce SDR Agent?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Piper (Qualified) is built for inbound, website-first pipeline generation. The Agentforce SDR Agent is built for outbound pipeline generation from CRM data and lead queues. They're complementary: Piper owns inbound; Agentforce SDR handles outbound. Note: Piper does not run on the Agentforce platform — these are two distinct products."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Do we need to replace our existing marketing automation tool (HubSpot, Marketo) to use Marketing Cloud?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Not necessarily. Piper (Qualified) works natively alongside Marketo, HubSpot, Oracle Eloqua, and Marketing Cloud — no rip and replace needed. For organizations ready to consolidate, Marketing Cloud Next offers a complete replacement with deeper CRM integration and unified AI."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"What are the benefits of B2B marketing automation platforms?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"The benefits of B2B marketing automation platforms are: \n\nScaling buyer engagement across accounts\nAligning revenue teams (marketing, sales, and service) to close deals faster\nGrowing pipeline and proving marketing impact"}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How can B2B marketing automation software help my business?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"B2B marketing automation software can help your business in the following ways:\n\nGenerating and nurturing leads\nDriving marketing and sales alignment\nPrioritizing and converting qualified leads\nManaging marketing campaigns\nExecuting on account-based marketing strategies\nMaximizing marketing ROI"}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How can I choose the right B2B marketing automation platform?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"The right B2B marketing automation platform will:\n\nIntegrate directly into your CRM\nAlign revenue teams (marketing, sales, and service)\nExecute on multiple marketing strategies (e.g., broad-base demand generation and account-based marketing)"}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How does B2B marketing on Salesforce connect marketing and sales into one revenue team?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Marketing and Sales run natively on the same platform and data. Unified Engagement History Dashboards give every sales rep a complete view of how each account engaged with marketing — emails opened, content downloaded, Piper conversations, webinar attendance — so every sales conversation picks up where marketing left off, with zero repeat-yourself moments."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"What is Marketing Cloud Next?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Marketing Cloud Next is Salesforce's complete agentic marketing platform for the entire customer lifecycle — where humans and AI agents work together to plan, create, optimize, and orchestrate adaptive customer experiences. Built natively on the Salesforce platform, it connects data, AI, automation, and engagement so every interaction stays connected and continuously improves."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"What is Marketing Cloud Account Engagement?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Marketing Cloud Account Engagement is the only marketing automation platform built on the world’s #1 CRM. It helps companies grow revenue and scale buyer engagement by uniting customer data on one platform and scaling account relationships with AI. Whether you’re looking to execute on-demand generation or account-based marketing strategies, we've got you covered."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"What is the difference between Marketing Cloud Next and Marketing Cloud Engagement and which should I use?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Marketing Cloud Engagement (formerly Pardot) is Salesforce's established B2B marketing automation platform, purpose-built for lead generation, nurturing, and sales-marketing alignment — deeply integrated with Salesforce CRM objects like Leads, Contacts, and Opportunities. Marketing Cloud Next is the next generation of Salesforce marketing, built natively on the Salesforce platform with Data 360 and Agentforce at its core. Where Account Engagement automates rules-based nurture, Marketing Cloud Next adds AI agents that engage in real two-way conversations, build audiences from plain language, and adapt campaigns continuously — across email, SMS, WhatsApp, and web. The good news: if you're already on Account Engagement, you don't have to choose. Every Account Engagement customer automatically gets access to Marketing Cloud features through Account Engagement +, with no migration required."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"What is Pardot?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Pardot was part of Exact Target, which was acquired by Salesforce in 2013, and is the legacy product name for Marketing Cloud Account Engagement. They are the same product."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Is Salesforce Account Engagement the same as Pardot?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Pardot is the legacy name for Salesforce Account Engagement and is the same product as Pardot."}}]}}</script>

From capturing and qualifying leads and accounts to nurturing buyers and accelerating deals with real-time insights, agents help your B2B teams drive more quality pipeline and ensure no lead is left behind.","name":"B2B Marketing Automation Software by Marketing Cloud","image":"https://wp.sfdcdigital.com/en-us/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/2026/06/marquee-image-720x720-1.webp","mainEntityOfPage":{"@type":"WebPage","@id":"https://www.salesforce.com/marketing/b2b-automation/","url":"https://www.salesforce.com/marketing/b2b-automation/","name":"B2B Marketing Automation Platform | Salesforce","description":"Marketing Cloud Account Engagement is a B2B marketing automation platform that helps you drive efficient growth with marketing and sales alignment.","datePublished":"2023-06-13","dateModified":"2026-09-28"},"subjectOf":{"@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"What is B2B marketing automation — and how is Marketing Cloud different?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"B2B marketing automation helps teams identify, engage, and convert buyers across the lifecycle. Traditional automation relied on rules and triggers. Marketing Cloud Next goes further: AI agents understand buyer intent in real time, engage in two-way conversations, adapt content to every individual, and operate across accounts and buying committees 24/7 — so your pipeline never stops generating."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"What is Piper, the AI SDR Agent, and how does it work?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Piper is the #1 AI SDR agent, part of Marketing Cloud through the Qualified acquisition. Piper converts high-intent website visitors, form fills, and inbound email leads into pipeline 24/7 — engaging via chat, voice, or video; answering questions; and booking meetings directly on the right rep's calendar. All activity logs automatically in CRM. #1 on G2 in AI SDR Agents, 4.9/5 from 1,500+ reviews. Live in 30–45 days, no SI required."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How is Piper different from the Agentforce SDR Agent?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Piper (Qualified) is built for inbound, website-first pipeline generation. The Agentforce SDR Agent is built for outbound pipeline generation from CRM data and lead queues. They're complementary: Piper owns inbound; Agentforce SDR handles outbound. Note: Piper does not run on the Agentforce platform — these are two distinct products."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Do we need to replace our existing marketing automation tool (HubSpot, Marketo) to use Marketing Cloud?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Not necessarily. Piper (Qualified) works natively alongside Marketo, HubSpot, Oracle Eloqua, and Marketing Cloud — no rip and replace needed. For organizations ready to consolidate, Marketing Cloud Next offers a complete replacement with deeper CRM integration and unified AI."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"What are the benefits of B2B marketing automation platforms?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"The benefits of B2B marketing automation platforms are: \n\nScaling buyer engagement across accounts\nAligning revenue teams (marketing, sales, and service) to close deals faster\nGrowing pipeline and proving marketing impact"}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How can B2B marketing automation software help my business?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"B2B marketing automation software can help your business in the following ways:\n\nGenerating and nurturing leads\nDriving marketing and sales alignment\nPrioritizing and converting qualified leads\nManaging marketing campaigns\nExecuting on account-based marketing strategies\nMaximizing marketing ROI"}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How can I choose the right B2B marketing automation platform?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"The right B2B marketing automation platform will:\n\nIntegrate directly into your CRM\nAlign revenue teams (marketing, sales, and service)\nExecute on multiple marketing strategies (e.g., broad-base demand generation and account-based marketing)"}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How does B2B marketing on Salesforce connect marketing and sales into one revenue team?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Marketing and Sales run natively on the same platform and data. Unified Engagement History Dashboards give every sales rep a complete view of how each account engaged with marketing — emails opened, content downloaded, Piper conversations, webinar attendance — so every sales conversation picks up where marketing left off, with zero repeat-yourself moments."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"What is Marketing Cloud Next?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Marketing Cloud Next is Salesforce's complete agentic marketing platform for the entire customer lifecycle — where humans and AI agents work together to plan, create, optimize, and orchestrate adaptive customer experiences. Built natively on the Salesforce platform, it connects data, AI, automation, and engagement so every interaction stays connected and continuously improves."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"What is Marketing Cloud Account Engagement?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Marketing Cloud Account Engagement is the only marketing automation platform built on the world’s #1 CRM. It helps companies grow revenue and scale buyer engagement by uniting customer data on one platform and scaling account relationships with AI. Whether you’re looking to execute on-demand generation or account-based marketing strategies, we've got you covered."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"What is the difference between Marketing Cloud Next and Marketing Cloud Engagement and which should I use?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Marketing Cloud Engagement (formerly Pardot) is Salesforce's established B2B marketing automation platform, purpose-built for lead generation, nurturing, and sales-marketing alignment — deeply integrated with Salesforce CRM objects like Leads, Contacts, and Opportunities. Marketing Cloud Next is the next generation of Salesforce marketing, built natively on the Salesforce platform with Data 360 and Agentforce at its core. Where Account Engagement automates rules-based nurture, Marketing Cloud Next adds AI agents that engage in real two-way conversations, build audiences from plain language, and adapt campaigns continuously — across email, SMS, WhatsApp, and web. The good news: if you're already on Account Engagement, you don't have to choose. Every Account Engagement customer automatically gets access to Marketing Cloud features through Account Engagement +, with no migration required."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"What is Pardot?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Pardot was part of Exact Target, which was acquired by Salesforce in 2013, and is the legacy product name for Marketing Cloud Account Engagement. They are the same product."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Is Salesforce Account Engagement the same as Pardot?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Pardot is the legacy name for Salesforce Account Engagement and is the same product as Pardot."}}]}}</script>

<script type="application/ld+json">{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Product","@id":"https://www.salesforce.com/marketing/b2b-automation/#Product","description":"Deploy an agency of agents across marketing and sales to act as one unified revenue team. From capturing and qualifying leads and accounts to nurturing buyers and accelerating deals with real-time insights, agents help your B2B teams drive more quality pipeline and ensure no lead is left behind.","name":"B2B Marketing Automation Software by Marketing Cloud","image":"https://wp.sfdcdigital.com/en-us/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/2026/06/marquee-image-720x720-1.webp","mainEntityOfPage":{"@type":"WebPage","@id":"https://www.salesforce.com/marketing/b2b-automation/","url":"https://www.salesforce.com/marketing/b2b-automation/","name":"B2B Marketing Automation Platform | Salesforce","description":"Marketing Cloud Account Engagement is a B2B marketing automation platform that helps you drive efficient growth with marketing and sales alignment.","datePublished":"2023-06-13","dateModified":"2026-09-28"},"subjectOf":{"@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"What is B2B marketing automation — and how is Marketing Cloud different?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"B2B marketing automation helps teams identify, engage, and convert buyers across the lifecycle. Traditional automation relied on rules and triggers. Marketing Cloud Next goes further: AI agents understand buyer intent in real time, engage in two-way conversations, adapt content to every individual, and operate across accounts and buying committees 24/7 — so your pipeline never stops generating."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"What is Piper, the AI SDR Agent, and how does it work?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Piper is the #1 AI SDR agent, part of Marketing Cloud through the Qualified acquisition. Piper converts high-intent website visitors, form fills, and inbound email leads into pipeline 24/7 — engaging via chat, voice, or video; answering questions; and booking meetings directly on the right rep's calendar. All activity logs automatically in CRM. #1 on G2 in AI SDR Agents, 4.9/5 from 1,500+ reviews. Live in 30–45 days, no SI required."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How is Piper different from the Agentforce SDR Agent?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Piper (Qualified) is built for inbound, website-first pipeline generation. The Agentforce SDR Agent is built for outbound pipeline generation from CRM data and lead queues. They're complementary: Piper owns inbound; Agentforce SDR handles outbound. Note: Piper does not run on the Agentforce platform — these are two distinct products."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Do we need to replace our existing marketing automation tool (HubSpot, Marketo) to use Marketing Cloud?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Not necessarily. Piper (Qualified) works natively alongside Marketo, HubSpot, Oracle Eloqua, and Marketing Cloud — no rip and replace needed. For organizations ready to consolidate, Marketing Cloud Next offers a complete replacement with deeper CRM integration and unified AI."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"What are the benefits of B2B marketing automation platforms?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"The benefits of B2B marketing automation platforms are: \n\nScaling buyer engagement across accounts\nAligning revenue teams (marketing, sales, and service) to close deals faster\nGrowing pipeline and proving marketing impact"}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How can B2B marketing automation software help my business?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"B2B marketing automation software can help your business in the following ways:\n\nGenerating and nurturing leads\nDriving marketing and sales alignment\nPrioritizing and converting qualified leads\nManaging marketing campaigns\nExecuting on account-based marketing strategies\nMaximizing marketing ROI"}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How can I choose the right B2B marketing automation platform?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"The right B2B marketing automation platform will:\n\nIntegrate directly into your CRM\nAlign revenue teams (marketing, sales, and service)\nExecute on multiple marketing strategies (e.g., broad-base demand generation and account-based marketing)"}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How does B2B marketing on Salesforce connect marketing and sales into one revenue team?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Marketing and Sales run natively on the same platform and data. Unified Engagement History Dashboards give every sales rep a complete view of how each account engaged with marketing — emails opened, content downloaded, Piper conversations, webinar attendance — so every sales conversation picks up where marketing left off, with zero repeat-yourself moments."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"What is Marketing Cloud Next?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Marketing Cloud Next is Salesforce's complete agentic marketing platform for the entire customer lifecycle — where humans and AI agents work together to plan, create, optimize, and orchestrate adaptive customer experiences. Built natively on the Salesforce platform, it connects data, AI, automation, and engagement so every interaction stays connected and continuously improves."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"What is Marketing Cloud Account Engagement?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Marketing Cloud Account Engagement is the only marketing automation platform built on the world’s #1 CRM. It helps companies grow revenue and scale buyer engagement by uniting customer data on one platform and scaling account relationships with AI. Whether you’re looking to execute on-demand generation or account-based marketing strategies, we've got you covered."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"What is the difference between Marketing Cloud Next and Marketing Cloud Engagement and which should I use?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Marketing Cloud Engagement (formerly Pardot) is Salesforce's established B2B marketing automation platform, purpose-built for lead generation, nurturing, and sales-marketing alignment — deeply integrated with Salesforce CRM objects like Leads, Contacts, and Opportunities. Marketing Cloud Next is the next generation of Salesforce marketing, built natively on the Salesforce platform with Data 360 and Agentforce at its core. Where Account Engagement automates rules-based nurture, Marketing Cloud Next adds AI agents that engage in real two-way conversations, build audiences from plain language, and adapt campaigns continuously — across email, SMS, WhatsApp, and web. The good news: if you're already on Account Engagement, you don't have to choose. Every Account Engagement customer automatically gets access to Marketing Cloud features through Account Engagement +, with no migration required."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"What is Pardot?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Pardot was part of Exact Target, which was acquired by Salesforce in 2013, and is the legacy product name for Marketing Cloud Account Engagement. They are the same product."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Is Salesforce Account Engagement the same as Pardot?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Pardot is the legacy name for Salesforce Account Engagement and is the same product as Pardot."}}]}}</script>
